plans.note: Only the preamble is exposed in the outline, but a Master Services Agreement of this type will contain a limitation of liability article; review the full body for a cap, mutuality and carve-outs (IP indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence).
Expect a Kubient indemnity for third-party IP infringement and its own misconduct elsewhere in the MSA; confirm AP's reciprocal indemnity is narrow (content/data supplied by AP only).
No non-compete visible in the outline; ad-tech MSAs rarely restrict the customer's lines of business. Scan any 'Exclusivity'/'Restrictive Covenants' text if the full body surfaces.
Nothing in the visible outline binds AP to buy solely from Kubient; verify no exclusive-supplier or exclusive-inventory language appears in the services or term provisions.
No pricing/MFN section is exposed. If fees or rate-card terms surface, check direction: MFN running to AP is acceptable, an MFN obliging AP to give Kubient best terms is not.
No non-solicitation clause visible; if one appears, confirm it is mutual, capped at 12 months and carves out general advertising and unsolicited applications.

The defined term 'Initial Term' signals a term/termination article outside the visible outline; look there for AP's right to terminate for convenience on notice without penalty and for any symmetrical vendor right.
'Initial Term' implies renewal mechanics; check the term article for auto-renewal, the non-renewal notice window (target 30 days) and any uncapped price uplift.
Expect governing law/venue in the miscellaneous article; confirm New York (both parties appear US-based) and court jurisdiction rather than arbitration.
Assignment normally sits in the miscellaneous article; check that AP may assign to affiliates/successors without consent and that a change of control does not give Kubient a termination right.
Ownership of deliverables, AP content and AP data will appear in an IP/data article; confirm no assignment or broad licence of AP IP or data to Kubient beyond what is needed to perform.
If the MSA grants AP a licence to a platform, check scope covers AP affiliates and contractors and is not revocable at will or limited to named users only.
No audit provision visible; if one surfaces, hold it to once per year, 10 business days' notice, off-site where possible and at Kubient's cost absent material underpayment.
No liquidated damages or penalty language exposed; watch the fees/termination provisions for early-termination fees or penalties payable by AP.
Expect vendor warranties in a representations/warranties article; confirm a services warranty of at least 90 days with re-performance or refund, and resist broad 'AS IS' disclaimers.
Insurance is often omitted from ad-tech MSAs; check the full body and, if absent, add commercial general liability, professional/tech E&O and cyber cover given Kubient handles AP data.
No fees or order-form section is exposed; verify no minimum spend, volume floor or take-or-pay commitment on AP without a termination-for-convenience exit.
Check the effects-of-termination provisions for return/deletion of AP data in a usable format and transition assistance at agreed rates; add if absent.
